intro: Judges is named for the leaders God raised up to rescue Israel, in the years after Joshua and before Israel had a king.
The same cycle repeats: the people turn from God, trouble comes, they cry out, and God sends a deliverer.
Chapters one and two set the scene. Chapters three to sixteen tell of the judges, including Deborah, Gideon and Samson. Chapters seventeen to twenty-one show how far things fell.
Its author isn't named; tradition credits Samuel.
Listen for the book's closing words: every man did that which was right in his own eyes.

card.parts: Ch. 1–2: the cycle begins | Ch. 3–16: the judges | Ch. 17–21: Israel at its lowest
card.listen: The cycle · God's mercy · the need for a true king
